name: Noor's Little Kiln
tagline: Hand-thrown pottery and hand-lettered cards, with your name on them.
bio: I throw mugs and small dishes on a wheel in my garage and letter cards at the kitchen table. Every piece is made for one person: their name pressed into the clay, their note in ink. Nothing comes from a warehouse.

shop.title: Seconds sale
shop.note: Mugs with tiny glaze quirks. Still perfect for coffee.

items.name: Set of 6 lettered cards
items.desc: Blank inside, a different word on each front.

experiences.name: Paint-your-own mug, for your team
experiences.desc: I bring bisque mugs, glazes and stamps. Everyone decorates their own; I fire them and ship them back two weeks later.
includes: Firing and delivery back to you
experiences.allIn: Materials, two firings, delivery and tax.

experiences.branding: Your logo stamp pressed into the base of every mug. Needs 3 weeks for the stamp.
experiences.access: Comes to your space; works seated at any table.
experiences.hybrid: Remote people get a bisque mug and glazes by mail and paint along on video.

giftNote: Made by hand, one name at a time. You get a photo proof of the lettering before anything goes in the kiln.

gifts.name: Name mug
gifts.desc: A hand-thrown 12 oz mug with their name pressed into the clay before it's fired. Pick a glaze; each one comes out a little different.
gifts.ships: Ships anywhere in the US, each to its own address
gifts.allIn: Gift box, tissue and a handwritten tag included.
personalize: Your logo stamp on the base

gifts.name: Stamped ring dish
gifts.desc: A small dish for keys or rings, stamped with a word or their initials.

gifts.name: Hand-lettered card
gifts.desc: Their name lettered on the front, your message written inside in ink. Optional: an instant photo of your team tucked in the corner.
personalize: An instant photo of your team

gifts.name: Instant-photo keepsake
gifts.desc: I shoot an instant photo at your offsite or launch, mount it on a lettered card with each person's name, and mail it to them a week later.
